issues.reason: The standing half: Names and casing fixes a name's extent mechanically as its capitalized run (plus a courtesy/office title kept in the string per the Dr-Okoro rule), so the comma-set appositive 'D-W.Va.' is not part of the name and the Name string mis-records it; the falling half: leaving the party-and-state content unencoded is correct, since no licensed head expresses party affiliation and 'Never coin a relation head' bars inventing one.

gaps_confirmed: abbreviated party-and-state appositive on a legislator's name ('D-W.Va.') — no licensed encoding for its content
proper-noun modifier of a common noun denoting affiliation ('the Senate bill') — Compound concepts covers only common-noun/adjective modifiers
repair_summary: Trimmed the Name string to its licensed extent, 'Sen. John Rockefeller', dropping the appositive party-and-state tag; no other atom touched.
notes: The improvised (Possession sk_bill_1 senate) is acceptable gap-territory improvisation — Possession is opaque and covers loose association — and the seal's projection split is right: definite provision and bill typings out, indefinite tenet's typing in.
